sup:70110.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Your letter gives 51 days' notice (doc:20260911-70110-P01), while our framework agreement requires 90 days (ctr:4600070110#3.1).
Our bottom-up cost model puts the full cost of this part at EUR 132.64 per unit (cost:310010).
Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -6.1% from 2025-11 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).

Please find 3 packages below. Each of them works for us; let us know which one suits you best.
If faster payment helps you, we are open to it, as shown in the packages.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. 

LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. 

We welcome your offer of 14 payment days, which we accept in exchange for a revised price of 133.70 EUR per unit. Our presentangebot is a price of €133.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. Alternatively, with valid from 1 January 2027: a price of €133.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 January 2027. 

Our standard terms apply to everything the quote does not state; see attached. This Angebot is valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. As to the delivery record data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. We checked the delivery scorecard data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We can accept the effective date of 1 January 2027 with 14 days payment terms, in exchange for a revised price of 131.20 EUR per unit.

For our complete proposal, our offer stands at a price of €131.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 January 2027. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing relationship and trust this significant step brings us to a mutual agreement.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
